title: Data Feedback Loops: Model-driven Amplification of Dataset Biases
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its key findings are that data feedback loops can amplify existing dataset biases, and that models exhibiting sampling-like behavior (through explicit sampling or implicit properties like distributional generalization) are more calibrated and stable against this amplification.
